mapper.sql: UUID, ACCOUNT, INDENTIFY_MARK, HOLDER_NAME, HOLDER_TYPE, HOLD_DATE, CCY, QTY, AMOUNT,STATUS,UPDATE_TIME,CREATE_TIME
mapper.insert:
MERGE INTO PBC_TARGET_INFO CII USING (
SELECT #{item.uuid,jdbcType=CHAR} UUID, #{item.account,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ACCOUNT, #{item.pbcProdId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} PBC_PROD_ID, #{item.indentifyMark,jdbcType=VARCHAR} INDENTIFY_MARK, #{item.holderName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} HOLDER_NAME, #{item.holderType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} HOLDER_TYPE, #{item.holdDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} HOLD_DATE, #{item.ccy,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CCY, #{item.qty,jdbcType=DECIMAL} QTY, #{item.amount,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AMOUNT, #{item.status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} STATUS, sysdate UPDATE_TIME, sysdate CREATE_TIME, #{item.createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_USER, #{item.updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UPDATE_USER FROM DUAL
) TEMP
ON(CII.ACCOUNT = TEMP.ACCOUNT AND CII.INDENTIFY_MARK = TEMP.INDENTIFY_MARK and CII.HOLD_DATE = TEMP.HOLD_DATE )
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET CII.HOLDER_NAME = TEMP.HOLDER_NAME, CII.HOLDER_TYPE = TEMP.HOLDER_TYPE, CII.CCY = TEMP.CCY, CII.QTY = TEMP.QTY, CII.AMOUNT = TEMP.AMOUNT, CII.UPDATE_TIME = TEMP.UPDATE_TIME, CII.UPDATE_USER = TEMP.UPDATE_USER, CII.STATUS = TEMP.STATUS
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( UUID,ACCOUNT,PBC_PROD_ID, INDENTIFY_MARK, HOLDER_NAME, HOLDER_TYPE, HOLD_DATE, CCY, QTY, AMOUNT,STATUS,UPDATE_TIME,CREATE_TIME, CREATE_USER, UPDATE_USER ) VALUES(TEMP.UUID,TEMP.ACCOUNT, TEMP.PBC_PROD_ID, TEMP.INDENTIFY_MARK, TEMP.HOLDER_NAME, TEMP.HOLDER_TYPE, TEMP.HOLD_DATE, TEMP.CCY, TEMP.QTY, TEMP.STATUS, TEMP.REV_DATE, TEMP.DATA_SOURCE, TEMP.UPDATE_USER, TEMP.UPDATE_TIME, TEMP.CREATE_TIME, TEMP.CREATE_USER, TEMP.UPDATE_USER )
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT t1.INSIDE_PROD_ID account, ifnull(t1.PBC_CODE,t2.PBC_PROD_ID) AS pbcProdId FROM PBC_PROD_ASSETPOOL_CODE t1 LEFT JOIN PBC_COL_PRD_BASEINFO_SUB t2 ON t1.INSIDE_PROD_ID = t2.PROD_ID
